B0872P4HX7.title: Broadlink Rm4 Pro Universal Remote with Sensor Cable,RF/IR Smart Remote
bullets: 【Universal RF & IR Control】 BroadLink Wi-Fi（2.4GHz Only, 5GHz or mesh networks not supported ）Smart Hub RM4 Pro works with 433MHz RF fixed-code devices (rolling code not supported), including motorized curtains, blinds, projectors, and light switches. It also supports 38KHz IR devices such as TVs, set-top boxes, ACs, fans, DVD players, and more. The IR library updates online to keep new devices compatible. If cloud data is unavailable, you can manually program or learn button commands.

【Smart Voice & App Control】 Use Alexa, Google, IFTTT, or Siri to voice-control your TV (power, volume, channels by number/name, input source, play, pause, FF, rewind, stop, previous/next) and AC (power, temp, fan speed, mode). The free BroadLink App also turns your phone into a smart remote for IR/RF devices, anywhere at home or away.

【FEATURES】 Create custom timers, scenes, and routines to automate your IR/RF home appliances. The hub supports external temperature and humidity detection for the room it’s placed in, displayed in the BroadLink App. Use these readings as triggers—for example, turn on your AC automatically when the temperature rises above your set point.

【Important Tech Notes】 Requires a stable 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network（Wi-Fi password containing special characters or exceeding 32 characters may result in a failed network connection). Confirm RF compatibility before purchase: 433MHz（430–440MHz range）, fixed code only（not rolling code）. Some curtain motors and ceiling fans may not work. RM4 Pro needs a 5V 1A USB adapter（not included） or equivalent power source.

【Real-Time Temp & Humidity Display】 Plug the external temperature and humidity sensor USB cable into your RM4 Pro, and the BroadLink App will instantly show the current temperature and humidity of the room.
